scope: Provisional productive possibilities, not registered experiments, demonstrated inventions or commercial offers.
selection_rule: Construct and test the missing means against the strongest complete alternative under matched total resources. A conventional solver may construct a genuinely new productive means; an already completed route that supplies the same accepted outcome within the same full budget defeats the alleged residual constraint.

capital_and_objective.funding_rule: No forecast is spendable cash. Any later execution must use the native accounts, retain liabilities and distinguish opening capital, debt and earned funding.

candidates.name: Construct passive mechanical behavior from contact geometry
candidates.new_accepted_outcome: A surface embodies a task-specific load response, potentially providing grasp regulation or overload accommodation without adding a sensor, processor or powered actuator. The target is a new accepted mechanical function, not merely a better fitted friction coefficient.
candidates.productive_arrangement: A reusable contact-law constructor produces a geometry blueprint, its validity envelope and an independently replayable response. Beneficiaries may commission distinct functional blueprints; sharing an instrument is not itself evidence that their outcomes are newly feasible.
strongest_complete_alternatives: Published Fu et al. height-only and height/radius NSGA-II constructors, including experimental calibration, measured fabrication errors, Monte Carlo sensitivity and wear tests.
Released JBil8 differentiable Sneddon contact model, inverse neural model, direct L-BFGS refinement and boundary-element validation where locally accessible.
Conventional passive geometry, compliant mechanisms and powered closed-loop control providing the same end-use behavior, including their full construction and validation costs.

residual_after_alternatives.hypothesis: Independent static-hold and dynamic-slide responses may require heterogeneous calibrated contact families: the homogeneous source model constrains their ratio to a constant for every height geometry. A mixture may remove that structural restriction, but an accepted use case, current complete alternative and physical transfer validity remain unresolved.
residual_after_alternatives.metric: Joint static/dynamic response error and end-use acceptance over source-supported calibration and manufacturing uncertainty, plus complete construction and validation cost.
residual_after_alternatives.warning: Authors already investigate fabrication errors and wear. Generic robustness is not an unresolved gap. Uniform wear may cancel in a normalized model. Heterogeneous-surface transfer of single-contact calibrations is not established, and separately fitted macroscopic friction stresses show that this issue cannot be ignored.

why_now.interpretation: Recent peer-reviewed publication supplies a concrete validated mechanism; code and preprint availability predate it. No new October-only computational capability or cost discontinuity is established.

candidates.missing_means_to_construct: A task-grounded combination of separately calibrated contact families, activation geometry and acceptance bridge that supplies a joint static/dynamic function. The exact end use, physical scale, uncertainty and comparator budgets must be frozen before optimization.
candidates.decisive_probe: Use the public single-contact calibration; freeze a joint static/dynamic requirement and uncertainty before search. First derive the homogeneous-model restriction, then compare a heterogeneous construction with the authors' constructor and strong direct optimization that may also construct new means. Independently recompute blueprints on off-grid loads and uncertainty. A model certificate must remain separate from mixed-surface physical validation. Preserve ties, failures and any complete existing route that already supplies the outcome.

available_resources.resource_status: Public code, source-data archives, preprint with supplementary information and publisher HTML downloaded and inspected. Exploratory fits suggest distinct family ratios, but a common origin coefficient is inconsistent with all supplied per-row error boxes for three of six family/response combinations. These boxes are not a joint confidence region; this is not a rejection of the authors' physical findings. No design result, future uncertainty guarantee or mixed-surface transfer qualification is recorded by this card.

candidates.commercial_dependency: A simulated buyer must prefer and accept the functional blueprint under a declared use contract. Every order must exercise the construction. Unknown physical qualification, demand, host/model billing and lifecycle costs remain unknown; a validated authors' example is not validation of a new target.
candidates.successor_frontier: A different passive end-use function becomes constructible from the retained calibrated instrument. An equally resourced successor may use the same public physics, build its own constructor or buy a complete alternative.
claim_limits: No new physical device has been fabricated or tested here.
No measured cost threshold, new industry, commercial GO or successor benefit is established.

candidates.name: Make inaccessible interior physical properties measurable
candidates.new_accepted_outcome: Determine a decision-relevant interior property from permitted boundary or archival observations when neither direct inspection nor an unqualified point reconstruction supports that decision. Consequences could include material acceptance and non-destructive infrastructure investigation; no diagnostic or safety certification is claimed.
candidates.productive_arrangement: Construct a property-specific instrument and a valid uncertainty or impossibility certificate, then deliver a measured answer or a justified refusal. A CSV co-occurrence series and a visually plausible reconstruction are insufficient substitutes.
strongest_complete_alternatives: Adjoint and finite-element inverse methods, regularization, Bayesian or set-valued uncertainty methods and conventional experiment design.
Existing KTC/KIT4 reconstruction pipelines and complete specialist interpretation workflows for the same property and data.
LLM-IDEA identifiability-driven experiment-class selection, direct frontier generalist construction and procuring an additional existing measurement operation where permitted.

residual_after_alternatives.hypothesis: A newly constructed measurement combination or physical operation may certify a property that the strongest existing complete route cannot certify within the same actual observation and resource budget.
residual_after_alternatives.metric: Property-interval width, held-out coverage, incorrect certification rate, abstention and complete accepted-answer cost.
residual_after_alternatives.warning: Null-space ambiguity cannot be removed by more reasoning on unchanged data. Full noiseless boundary uniqueness is not a finite-data stable reconstruction guarantee.

why_now.relevant_public_result: OpenAI family 372 manuscript dated 2026-09-24; the public formalization scope describes uniqueness, not a reconstruction algorithm.
why_now.recent_incumbent: LLM-IDEA preprint dated 2026-10-08 already detects identifiability limits and recommends changed experiment classes.
why_now.data_availability: KIT4 and KTC data predate 2026. They are available test resources, not new capability discontinuities.
why_now.interpretation: A specific finite, noise-robust instrument still has to be invented and tested. No practical why-now threshold is established by the theorem or agent alone.

candidates.missing_means_to_construct: A realizable observation operation and independently checkable bridge from those observations to the required hidden property. This must change information or justified productive feasibility, rather than attach a generic observability checker.
candidates.decisive_probe: On public physical KIT4/KTC tank measurements, preregister a property and withheld phantoms, then compare honest uncertainty and refusal with strong conventional pipelines. Conductivity data can test a conductivity instrument; they cannot validate the separate three-dimensional elasticity theorem. If identical observations admit opposed property decisions, retain the impossibility witness and require a genuinely different observation operation.

available_resources.resource_status: Dataset provenance and primary documentation inspected; no new measurement result executed for this card.

candidates.commercial_dependency: A simulated contract buys a specified decision-useful answer with acceptance tied to physical reference evidence and stated uncertainty. An unsupported signal estimate must produce refusal or failure rather than revenue. Real buyer values, acquisition costs and liability terms are unobserved.
candidates.successor_frontier: A different hidden physical property becomes investigable because the first instrument supplies a newly calibrated channel or operation. Reusing an existing solver alone does not establish expansion.
claim_limits: The OpenAI uniqueness statement has full-data smooth-domain assumptions and supplies no reconstruction procedure.
No physical sensing breakthrough, new observation channel, calibrated economic threshold or Blue Sky GO is established.

candidates.name: Turn unusable feedstock into further productive means
candidates.new_accepted_outcome: A complete conversion, separation and manufacture chain transforms a specified otherwise rejected feedstock into a qualified productive input or component, with necessary consumables and energy honestly supplied. Its outputs could enable further construction rather than only sale of a commodity.
candidates.productive_arrangement: Search reaction operations, separation, impurity tolerance, coproduct uses, participant terms and construction finance together. Produce an independently balanced, executable process specification; account for equipment, kinetics, losses and residual obligations.
strongest_complete_alternatives: Conventional process synthesis, equilibrium thermochemistry, extractive metallurgy, recycle design and procurement of qualified feedstock or components.
NASA molten-regolith-electrolysis and carbothermal systems, including complete plant studies.
Blue Origin Blue Alchemist already integrates regolith simulant processing with oxygen, metal and solar-cell outputs; merely proposing that chain does not establish a missing means.

residual_after_alternatives.hypothesis: A specified downstream purification, forming or manufacturing operation may close a genuinely missing productive chain. A 2024 NASA model identified a missing high-TRL downstream-metal-handling subsystem model; that historical gap must be reassessed against current complete systems.
residual_after_alternatives.metric: Qualified useful output, species and impurity balance, net energy and reagent requirements, feasible kinetics, equipment compatibility and complete delivered cost.
residual_after_alternatives.warning: Balanced stoichiometry or favorable equilibrium alone does not demonstrate a manufacturable process, physical self-replication or positive economics.

why_now.interpretation: Modern APIs and thermochemical databases support executable search. They do not establish a recent scientific discontinuity or demonstrate that the historical process gap persists.

candidates.missing_means_to_construct: A specific validated conversion or manufacturing operation that closes the selected chain after the strongest complete alternative is considered. It cannot be a route-optimization dashboard over already complete operations.
candidates.decisive_probe: Use pinned public thermochemical species and feedstock evidence to synthesize a complete candidate chain. Independently replay mass, charge, energy, impurity and equipment constraints and compare against the complete NASA/industrial route and ordinary process synthesis. Identify required kinetic or physical evidence explicitly. A local thermodynamic calculation can falsify a chain; it cannot alone certify industrial operation.

available_resources.thermochemical_engine: NASA CEA public source and documentation
available_resources.thermochemical_species_count_scope: Documentation describes more than 2000 species, not guaranteed coverage of the selected feedstock/process.
available_resources.resource_status: Primary source descriptions inspected; no conversion, process construction or qualified output executed for this card.

candidates.commercial_dependency: A first simulated delivery must sell the specific qualified output or validated productive operation, include all construction and lifecycle costs, and allow procurement of an ordinary substitute. No simulated earnings may be attributed to unvalidated physical manufacture.
candidates.successor_frontier: The resulting qualified material or component enables a different productive operation under matched starting resources. Purchasing an adapter after preconstructing its output is not evidence of causal new-capability construction.
claim_limits: No physical manufacturing action or acquisition is authorized by this card.
No current downstream gap, autonomous industrial closure, economic qualification or route to US$3 billion is established.
